title: Post-Doctoral Research Visit F/M Distributed Learning for Streaming Data
institution: Inria (Centre Inria de Lyon, MARACAS team)
about: Postdoctoral research position on distributed learning for streaming data with the MARACAS team at Centre Inria de Lyon, Villeurbanne, within the PRIDeL Associate Team. The 16-month contract targets a start by 1 January 2027; applications close 31 December 2026.
requirements: PhD defended no later than 31 December 2026
Supervised by Dr. Malcolm Egan (Inria) and Dr. Hsuan-Yin Lin (Simula), with Prof. Yu-Chih Huang (NYCU), within the PRIDeL Associate Team

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods II
why: "Distributed learning" (record skill) → "Federated learning: distributed training while preserving data privacy"
"Machine learning" (record skill) → "Transfer learning and domain adaptation: reusing knowledge across tasks"
